title: 177 The Weekend - Decorating a Christmas Tree

content.text: Hello English learners and welcome back to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
content.trans: 你好，英语学习者们，欢迎再次来到英语有声课堂。我的名字是Marco。

content.text: And my name is Catherine and it's the Christmas season Marco so that means we have a very festive lesson today.
content.trans: 我叫凯瑟琳，这是圣诞节季节，所以今天我们有一个非常热闹的课。

content.text: That's right. Christmas is coming up and well a tradition among many people around the world is to buy a Christmas tree.
content.trans: 没错。圣诞节快到了，世界各地很多人中的一项传统就是买圣诞树。

content.text: That's right I remember when we used to do this in my family it was one of my favorite times of the year.
content.trans: 那是我记起来，我们以前在家里做这个的时候，是我最喜欢的季节之一。

content.text: So we're going to explore this in today's lesson after we listen to the dialogue we'll be back to talk about some of these interesting words and phrases.
content.trans: 所以，今天我们课程的最后部分将探讨一下我们在听对话时会提到的一些有趣词汇和短语。

content.text: I'm home. Everyone come here. I bought a Christmas tree. Look at this beautiful pine tree.
content.trans: 我回来了。大家快来这边。我买了一棵圣诞树。看这个美丽的松树。

content.text: Wow it's huge. Are you sure it will fit in the living room?
content.trans: 哇，好大啊。你确定它会放进客厅吗？

content.text: Awesome. I'll go get the Christmas lights. Of course it will. Help me put it in the living room.
content.trans: awesome. 我会去拿圣诞灯的。 当然会。帮我把它们放在客厅里吧。

content.text: I found the lights. I got the Christmas ornaments. We could also place these stockings next to the chimney.
content.trans: 我找到了灯。我拿到了圣诞装饰品。我们还可以把这些袜子放在烟囱旁边。

content.text: Great idea. While we decorate the tree we can listen to some good old Christmas songs.
content.trans: 好主意。我们在装饰圣诞树的同时，可以听听一些经典的圣诞歌曲。

content.text: All right we're back and as we mentioned the entire dialogue is about a Christmas tree.
content.trans: 好的，我们回来了。正如我们提到的，整个对话都是关于一棵圣诞树的。

content.text: So why don't you explain what a Christmas tree is because many people maybe don't even do or buy Christmas trees.
content.trans: 所以你为什么不解释一下圣诞树是什么，因为很多人可能甚至都不知道怎么制作或购买圣诞树。

content.text: Okay well Christmas tree is usually a green tree that we cut down and we put in the house.
content.trans: 好的，圣诞树通常是一棵我们砍倒的绿色树。

content.text: So it's not a real tree with roots in the ground but sometimes it comes from a real tree outside and the tree is very small on the top and it goes out like a triangle.
content.trans: 所以，它并不是真的长在地里的树，有时候它是从外面的一棵真正的树上长出来的，顶部很小，像一个三角形一样伸出来。

content.text: Okay so it's a special shape and we generally make it look very pretty with lights and ornaments and decorations and on Christmas on the 25th or the 24th it depends where you come from.
content.trans: 好的，这是一个特别的形状。我们通常会用灯光、装饰品和装饰物来让它看起来非常漂亮，在12月25日或24日（取决于你来自哪里），这取决于你在哪里。

content.text: We put lots of presents underneath the Christmas tree.
content.trans: 我们把很多礼物放在圣诞树下面。

content.text: Wow it sounds amazing. Well yeah and it looks very nice.
content.trans: 哇，听起来很棒。嗯，确实看起来很漂亮。

content.text: It does look really beautiful and it's just a really special part of Christmas.
content.trans: 看起来真的很漂亮，而且这也是圣诞节非常特别的一部分。

content.text: And well as you mentioned sometimes the tree is just a fake plastic tree but many times it's a real tree and the type of tree that you use is a pine tree.
content.trans: 而且，正如你所提到的，有时候树只是个假塑料树，但很多时候它是一棵真正的树，你使用的树种是松树。

content.text: Exactly and so pine tree is a kind of tree that doesn't have leaves. It has needles.
content.trans: 确实，松树是一种没有叶子的树木。它有针叶。

content.text: That means that they're long very thin green pieces that are all over the tree and you can see these trees in most northern places like Scandinavia or in America maybe Illinois and Minnesota and Michigan and Vermont.
content.trans: 这意味着它们是长而薄的绿色片，遍布在树上，你可以在大多数北半球的地方看到这些树木，比如斯堪的纳维亚或美国的一些地方，如伊利诺伊州、明尼苏达州和密歇根州以及佛蒙特州。

content.text: And they're very as you say very unique trees but they also have a very special smell, the smell of pine.
content.trans: 而且它们确实是你说的非常独特的树，但它们也有一种特别的香味，那就是松树的味道。

content.text: They do. It's very nice.
content.trans: 他们这样做。真是太好了。

content.text: It's such a nice smell that a lot of the things that we use in America to clean our houses have a pine smell because it makes the house smell nice.
content.trans: 这种香味真是太好了，因为我们用在美国家里清洁的很多东西都有松树的味道，这能让房子闻起来很香。

content.text: Very good. So a pine tree. The dad brought a pine tree or a Christmas tree home and well the wife was a little bit worried if it will fit.
content.trans: 很好。所以是一棵松树。爸爸带回家了一棵松树或者圣诞树，妻子有点担心它会不会合适。

content.text: Okay will it fit? This is a very important question because a lot of pine trees are very very tall.
content.trans: 好的，它会不会太大了？这是一个非常重要问题，因为很多的松树都长得非常高。

content.text: So if a pine tree is three meters tall or four meters tall will it fit? Is the question we ask? Is it too big or is it going to be stuck on the ceiling in the house?
content.trans: 那么，如果一棵树高三米或者四米，它会不会合适呢？我们问的是这个问题吗？太高了还是会被挂在房顶？

content.text: And so we could ask this about anything. I just bought a new TV.
content.trans: 所以，我们可以问任何关于它的问题。我刚刚买了一台新的电视。

content.text: Will it fit in the living room?
content.trans: 它适合放在客厅吗？

content.text: I don't know. I'm very nervous. I spend a lot of money.
content.trans: 我也不清楚。我很紧张。我花了很多钱。

content.text: Well you were talking about the Christmas tree and how you put a lot of nice decorations on it. So we say that we decorate the tree.
content.trans: 你正在谈论圣诞树，以及你在上面挂了很多漂亮的装饰品。所以我们说我们装饰了这棵树。

content.text: That's right. So the verb here, this is an action word, to decorate. So every holiday season in my family we take one day and we decorate the tree.
content.trans: 正确。所以这里的动词，这是一个行为动词，用来装饰。因此，在我家庭的每个节日季节里，我们都会选择一天来装饰树。

content.text: That means that we take very small special ornaments and ribbons and lights and we put them on the tree to make the tree look pretty.
content.trans: 那就是我们把非常小的特别装饰品和丝带、灯泡放在树上，让树看起来很漂亮。

content.text: You can also say decorate the house or to decorate the house for a party. So this means to make something look special or pretty.
content.trans: 你可以这样说，装饰房子或者为聚会装饰房子。所以这意味着让某物看起来特别或漂亮。

content.text: Very good. We've taken a look at very specific words related to Christmas trees and decorating it. So why don't we listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back to continue with some more language takeaway.
content.trans: 很好。我们已经对与圣诞树和装饰相关的非常具体的一些词汇进行了审视。那么为什么不再次聆听这段对话，然后我们将继续进行一些更多的语言取经？

content.text: I'm home. Everyone come here. I bought a Christmas tree. Look at this beautiful pine tree.
content.trans: 我回来了。大家快来这边。我买了一棵圣诞树。看这个美丽的松树。

content.text: Wow, it's huge. Are you sure it will fit in the living room?
content.trans: 哇，好大啊。你确定它会放进客厅吗？

content.text: Awesome. I'll go get the Christmas lights.
content.trans: awesome. 我去拿圣诞灯吧。

content.text: Of course it will. Help me put it in the living room.
content.trans: 当然会。帮我把它放在客厅里吧。

content.text: I found the lights. I got the Christmas ornaments. We could also place these stockings next to the chimney.
content.trans: 我找到了灯。我拿到了圣诞饰品。我们还可以把这些袜子放在烟囱旁边。

content.text: Great idea. While we decorate the tree we can listen to some good old Christmas songs.
content.trans: 好主意。我们在装饰树的同时，可以听听一些老式的圣诞歌曲。

content.text: Alright, we're back. So why don't we take a look at three more words on language takeaway part two.
content.trans: 好的，我们又回来了。不如让我们看看语言取经第二部分的三个更多单词吧。

content.text: Language takeaway. There's just so many words that are associated with Christmas and the Christmas season that we have to look at them again here in language takeaway part two.
content.trans: 语言取经。这里在语言取经第二部分再次接触到那么多与圣诞节和圣诞节相关的词汇，不得不重新审视一下。

content.text: The first one we've already mentioned it goes together with the phrase to decorate the tree.
content.trans: 我们已经提到的第一个就是和装饰树搭配的。

content.text: What do we decorate the tree with Marco?
content.trans: 我们用什么装饰树，马可？

content.text: You mentioned ornaments. Christmas ornaments.
content.trans: 你提到饰品。圣诞饰品。

content.text: Christmas ornaments. So an ornament is a thing. It's something that we use to make something else look prettier.
content.trans: 圣诞饰品。所以，一个装饰品是一个东西。它是用来使其他东西看起来更漂亮的某种物品。

content.text: In this case ornaments are sometimes round and red or green or gold. We hang them on the tree.
content.trans: 在这种情况下，装饰品有时是圆形的、红色的、绿色的或金色的。我们挂在树上。

content.text: In this case it's a Christmas ornament for the tree. But an ornament can be anything.
content.trans: 在这个情况下，它是一个圣诞装饰品用于树上。但是，装饰品可以是任何东西。

content.text: Any nice piece of art or something that you can use to decorate your house.
content.trans: 任何一件精美的艺术品或你可以用来装饰房屋的东西。

content.text: Exactly. In my family ornaments aren't just those round circles or balls for Christmas.
content.trans: Exactly. 在我家的装饰品不仅仅是圣诞节时那些圆形或球形的东西。

content.text: Every family member has a special kind of ornament. So my dad has Santa Claus ornaments.
content.trans: 每个家庭成员都有一个特别的装饰品。所以我的爸爸有圣诞老人的装饰品。

content.text: And my mom has bunny rabbit ornaments. And I have angel ornaments. So everybody has a special one.
content.trans: 我妈妈有兔子形状的装饰品，而我有天使形状的饰品。所以每个人都有一个特别的东西。

content.text: That's really nice. And well apart from ornaments there is also the tradition of hanging stockings.
content.trans: 那真是太好了。除了装饰品之外，还有悬挂圣诞袜的传统。

content.text: Okay. So a stocking you might have heard this word before in the sense of a clothing item. A stocking is like a sock.
content.trans: 好的。这个词你可能在衣物上听过，比如袜子。

content.text: A big sock.
content.trans: 笨蛋相机

content.text: And it also means old stockings that women would wear. Like tights.
content.trans: 而且，这也意味着女人会穿的旧袜子。就像长筒袜。

content.text: But in this case a stocking, a Christmas stocking is a very very very big sock that we hang.
content.trans: 但在这个情况下，一条袜子——一个非常非常非常大的袜子——我们挂在那儿。

content.text: And on Christmas we get to fill it with very special things like candy and toys.
content.trans: 而且在圣诞节，我们可以把它填满非常特别的东西，比如糖果和玩具。

content.text: Candy toys very good. So actually you hang the stockings and the common place to do it in or to put them on is on the chimney right?
content.trans: 糖果玩具很好。所以实际上你挂袜子的地方通常是在烟囱里，对吧？

content.text: That's right. So there's a fireplace and usually above the fireplace there's a shelf we call it a mantle.
content.trans: 没错。所以通常在壁炉上方有一个我们称之为壁架的东西。

content.text: And there's a place there to hang these. And the place where all of the smoke from the fire comes out is the chimney.
content.trans: 而且，那里有一个地方可以挂这些。而火的所有烟雾都从烟囱里排出的地方就是那个地方。

content.text: It's also the place where Santa Claus comes down.
content.trans: 这是圣诞老人下凡的地方。

content.text: Right. So you have the fireplace where you put the wood. You have the mantle that's the space where you actually put the stockings on.
content.trans: 好的。所以你有一个火炉，里面放木头；还有一个壁炉架，那是你可以实际挂袜子的空间。

content.text: And the tube that goes up and where the smoke comes out of is called the chimney.
content.trans: 并且，从烟囱里出来的那根管子叫做烟道。

content.text: Right. So you don't want to live there. And then actually the joke is that Santa Claus is definitely too fat to go down the chimney.
content.trans: 好的。所以你不想在那里生活。然后实际上，圣诞老人肯定太胖了，爬不进烟囱。

content.text: But it's a special place in the Christmas story because that's what Santa Claus does.
content.trans: 但是，它在圣诞故事中是一个特别的地方，因为那是圣诞老人所做的。

content.text: Very good. Interesting words. Why don't we listen to this dialogue one last time?
content.trans: 很好。有趣的话。我们再听一遍这个对话好吗？

content.text: I'm home. Everyone come here. I bought a Christmas tree. Look at this beautiful pine tree.
content.trans: 我回来了。大家都过来吧。我买了一棵圣诞树。看这个美丽的松树。

content.text: Wow. It's huge. Are you sure it will fit in the living room?
content.trans: 哇。好大啊。你确定它会放进客厅吗？

content.text: Awesome. I'll go get the Christmas lights. Of course it will. Help me put it in the living room.
content.trans: awesome. 我会去拿圣诞灯的。当然了，它一定会有的。帮我把它放在客厅里吧。

content.text: I found the lights. I got the Christmas ornaments. We could also place these stockings next to the chimney.
content.trans: 我找到了灯。我拿到了圣诞装饰品。我们还可以把这些袜子放在烟囱旁边。

content.text: Great idea. While we decorate the tree we can listen to some good old Christmas songs.
content.trans: 好主意。我们在装饰圣诞树的同时，可以听听一些经典的圣诞歌曲。

content.text: Alright, we're back. So as you say the Christmas season is important in America and people not only decorate Christmas trees but also their house.
content.trans: 好的，我们又回来了。正如你所说，在美国圣诞节季节非常重要，并且人们不仅装饰圣诞树，还会装饰他们的房子。

content.text: And even outside they put Christmas lights all over the house. They put little statues of Santa Claus in reindeer.
content.trans: 而且，他们甚至在房子外面也挂满了圣诞灯。他们还把小驯鹿的圣诞老人雕像放在那里。

content.text: It's a very, I don't know, sometimes out lavish thing to do.
content.trans: It's a very, I don't know, sometimes out lavish thing to do. (注：这句话是中文，但可能需要根据上下文进行调整。)

content.text: It is. It's almost funny how much people like to spend on not just time but also money on decorating their houses.
content.trans: 这是。人们竟然花在装饰房子上的时间几乎和金钱一样多，简直让人觉得好笑。

content.text: And so where I come from people decorate the outside a lot. You have Christmas lights on all parts of the house.
content.trans: 所以，我来自的地方人们装饰的很多。你家里的房子到处都有圣诞灯。

content.text: And then maybe all of the reindeer in the front yard.
content.trans: 然后，也许院子里所有的驯鹿。

content.text: They're like 12 of them or 9 of them I don't remember.
content.trans: 他们大概有十二个，或者是九个我记不清了。

content.text: But actually it was nice because when I lived there with my parents we would go out and tour around the neighborhood just to see other people's Christmas lights and decorations.
content.trans: 但其实挺好的，因为我住在那里的时候，和父母一起出去转转，只是为了看看别人的圣诞灯饰和装饰。

content.text: Because as we say some of them can be very, very nice and they take a lot of time and effort into decorating it.
content.trans: 因为正如我们所说的，其中一些确实非常漂亮，而且它们需要投入大量的时间和精力进行装饰。

content.text: They do. It's really special. And at my house we generally just decorated the inside.
content.trans: 他们这样做。这真的很特别。而且在我家，我们通常只是装饰了内部。

content.text: And sometimes we did lights on the outside. And there are some very funny movies to talk about this like National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation.
content.trans: 而且有时候我们会把灯打开。像《全国假日好猫》这样的电影，谈论这个是非常有趣的。

content.text: And so there are some really funny scenes about putting Christmas lights on the house.
content.trans: 于是，有些关于把圣诞灯挂在房子外面的非常有趣的情景。

content.text: Alright well that's all the time we have for today but we'll definitely post a link of this movie that's actually very good.
content.trans: 好的，那今天的时间就到此为止了。不过我们一定会发布这部电影的链接，这是一部非常不错的电影。

content.text: It kind of depicts the traditional American in a funny way.
content.trans: 它有点儿以一种有趣的方式描绘了传统美国的形象。

content.text: It's a very funny movie.
content.trans: 这是一个非常有趣的电影。

content.text: And if you have any questions any other doubts or comments you can come to EnglishPod.com and we'll see you there.
content.trans: 而且如果你有任何其他问题、疑问或者评论，都可以来到英语有声网（英语：英语pod．com）那里，我们会在那儿见。

content.text: We will also enjoy the Christmas season until next time guys. Bye!
content.trans: 我们还会在接下来的时间里继续享受圣诞节的时光，大家再见！
